title: How Rupert Murdoch's dad + Emu Wars changed today's media
summary: How Keith Murdoch's papers covered Australia's 1932 Emu War, which was called off over press reports, and what it shows about who controls the news.

description:
EMUS 1, ARMY 0. That's the meme. The reality: the farmers got the bill. The family behind Fox News got the playbook.

The army brought machine guns. Keith Murdoch's papers brought the jokes. His son Rupert later built The Sun, The Wall Street Journal and Fox News.

Heather believes the version everybody learned. Edwin brought the receipts. History, allegedly.

THE PRINTED ISSUE
SIDE EYE: The Loser's Issue. Cover story: "The Emus Didn't Win. The Newspapers Did." Everything we can prove and everything we can't, side by side. Includes EMU COMMANDO, with real newspaper action! Victory not included. Bullets billed separately.

Get it on Amazon: https://a.co/d/02FwgFhM
Or search "side eye magazine"

ONE QUESTION FOR THE COMMENTS
Who actually won the Emu War? You're not allowed to say "the emus."
